verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that ElevenLabs Agents is a HIPAA-eligible service, that BAAs are offered to eligible customers, and that customers can build agents handling PHI. Configurable transcript and audio retention adds some compliance control. The pack has no evidence of a SOC 2 attestation or data-residency options; 'enterprise-grade security' is a generic marketing claim. Missing for 10: SOC 2 report or attestation evidence, data-residency or region-selection options, independent corroboration of HIPAA/BAA support.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can run regulated workloads with HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2, and data-residency options

citations.quote: ElevenLabs Agents is one of ElevenLabs' HIPAA-eligible services, and we offer Business Associate Agreements (BAAs) to eligible customers
ElevenLabs allows such customers to develop AI-powered voice agents for the handling Protected Health Information (PHI)
Retention settings allow you to configure how long your conversational agent stores conversation transcripts and audio recordings.
